speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Since independence, Singapore has pursued economic growth in tandem with social inclusion and environmental protection.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: This is the foundation for the green and liveable city that we enjoy today.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: However, we cannot take our success for granted.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In a global landscape characterised by pandemics, climate change, and resource constraints, sustainability has become increasingly important.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Sustainability is the principle that in meeting the needs of current generations, we should not compromise the ability of future generations to meet their needs.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: It has always been part of Singapore's DNA.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: But we will push for it to be at the heart of our plans, policies, and processes.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: This renewed commitment is reflected in our name change to the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE).

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to work with all segments of society and the economy to realise our vision for a sustainable Singapore, as we ride out COVID-19 and beyond.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As an immediate priority, we will shore up Singapore's environmental public health resilience as a first line of defence against the transmission of COVID-19 and dengue.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will strengthen our environmental sanitation controls, upgrade public health infrastructure in hawker centres and coffeeshops, and rally Singaporeans to uplift and sustain cleanliness and public hygiene norms.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The disruption of global supply chains amidst COVID-19 is a reminder of why we must take Singapore's food security seriously.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will play our part to support those affected by the economic downturn through meaningful jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: For example, in Phase Two of re-opening, agencies working with MSE have hired about 1,900 temporary staff from industries such as aviation and hospitality as Safe Distancing Ambassadors and SG Clean Ambassadors, who are helping to educate the public on safe distancing measures and promote positive social norms.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We are also hiring more staff for our enhanced dengue management efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As we respond to immediate challenges, we look to the future to ensure that Singapore emerges stronger and more sustainable.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In public health, we will further improve the way public health threats are managed.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Besides scaling up Project Wolbachia as an important complement to our dengue fighting toolkit, we piloted a cutting-edge wastewater-based epidemiology programme that enables the early detection of COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will explore how this programme can be scaled and applied to other infectious diseases.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will keep sight of the longer-term existential threats from climate change.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will push for a green recovery from COVID-19, to support a competitive transition to a low-carbon and climate-resilient future.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will drive and coordinate public sector efforts to take the lead in sustainable development, and ensure that sustainability is at the heart of the MSE family of agencies' core functions.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: For example, we will develop Tuas Nexus to maximise energy and resource recovery by harnessing synergies between solid waste and water treatment processes; PUB will generate sufficient solar energy to power all of its local waterworks by 2021.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will promote green growth, ride on opportunities from decarbonisation, and grow green industries such as carbon services and climate science.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will encourage and support companies to reduce their carbon footprint, and explore new private-public collaborations to make Singapore a leading example of how economic prosperity and environmental sustainability can go hand-in-hand.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will invest heavily in research and development for climate action.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The challenges of COVID-19 and climate change, together with other trade and environmental pressures, pose a threat to Singapore's supply of critical resources like food and water.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will ensure that Singapore's critical resources remain uncompromised for both present and future generations.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We aim to reduce household water consumption from 141 to 130 litres per capita per day by 2030.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will continue to unlock more spaces for farming, by encouraging sea-based farming in the deeper southern waters of Singapore, and bring food production closer to communities, such as on the rooftops of HDB multi-storey carparks.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also masterplan Lim Chu Kang and develop the Agri-Food Innovation Park to create a vibrant and sustainable agri-food ecosystem and provide good job opportunities for the agri-food workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In an increasingly resource-constrained world, we will continue to pursue Circular Economy approaches and work towards our vision of a zero-waste nation.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also mandate key responsibilities to enable re-using and recycling nation-wide for our priority waste streams of food, ewaste, and packaging, and support the localisation of our recycling capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As we strengthen food security, we will create skilled jobs in the high-tech agriculture and aquaculture industry.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also continue to promote joint responsibility for food safety assurance with the industry by training more Food Hygiene Officers (FHOs) and Advanced FHOs, who will serve as food safety guardians at food establishments.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will also help cleaning and waste management professionals enhance their skillset and take on more specialised roles in disinfection, recycling, or waste treatment.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will develop a pipeline of talent to support sustainability in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will offer scholarships for people passionate about our mission, in areas such as climate adaptation and climate science, and train a workforce that is ready for the sustainability challenges and opportunities of the future.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We are committed to achieving our long-term environmental goals by working together with partners in the People, Private and Public (3P) sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We will tap on their energy, experiences, and ideas to co-create and co-deliver solutions for Singapore through consultations, collaborations, and initiatives such as Citizens' Workgroups and SG Eco Towns.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Available to the 3P sectors, this fund will enable every Singaporean to contribute to environmental sustainability.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MSE will do its part to keep Singapore at the forefront of public health, climate action, and resource security, with sustainability at the core.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: We ask all Singaporeans to work with us to make Singapore a green and liveable home and a global champion for sustainability.
